Aloisii Gonzagæ = 圣路易·冈扎加 (Luigi Gonzaga). S. Alberti Magni = 圣大伯多禄 is incorrect — 圣大雅博 (Albertus Magnus = 大雅博); corrected in output to 圣大雅博. S. Anselmi = 圣安瑟莫. S. Bernardini Senensis = 锡耶纳的圣伯纳定 (Bernardine of Siena, distinct from Bernard of Clairvaux = 伯尔纳铎). S. Birgittæ = 圣碧嘉德 (Birgitta of Sweden). S. Catharinæ Senensis = 锡耶纳的圣加大利纳. S. Cœlestini = 圣则肋定. S. Cunegundis = 圣贵内贡达. Toponym 'Frisingensi' (Freising) rendered as 弗赖辛. 'almæ Urbis' = 圣城 (Rome). English-language entries (3424, 3425, 3440, 3476, 3506) translated from English directly. S. Bathonis Confessoris: 'Batho' is obscure; tentatively 圣巴托, flagged. S. Anastasii IX = 亚纳大削九世 (likely Anastasius IX, a minor pontificate). S. Conradi a Parzham = 圣康拉德·冯·帕尔蔡姆 (Conrad of Parzham). S. Clementis Mariæ Hofbauer = 圣克莱孟·玛利亚·霍夫鲍尔. Albert the Great corrected: 圣大雅博 (not 圣大伯多禄).
